purpose: Source-backed and ABI-v9 controls for valid current Moss generic body shapes, with staged-v10 outcomes recorded by oracle.py.

cases.category: zero-argument open Vector result and independent element specializations
cases.consumer:
module Main
import Service

fn main():
  numbers = Service.fresh()
  numbers.push(7)
  echo numbers
  flags = Service.fresh()
  flags.push(true)
  echo flags
cases.checked_body_status: The direct-return provider emits under MOSS_STAGED_ABI=v10 alone; the 19-case R0 recheck passes source-backed, ABI-v9, and ABI-v10 Debug/Release for this case. Source-deleted Int/Bool projection, hostile controls, and the ABI-v9 control also pass in R2c.

cases.category: zero-argument open result and private generic dependency closure
cases.consumer:
module Main
import Service

fn main():
  values = Service.relay()
  values.push(17)
  echo values
  flags = Service.relay()
  flags.push(true)
  echo flags
cases.checked_body_status: v10 must prove both relay and fresh projection or reject the selected chain; legacy bodies for both are poisoned.

cases.category: provider-owned nominal construction and field identity
cases.consumer:
module Main
import Service

fn main():
  number = Service.wrap(7)
  echo number.value
  text = Service.wrap("moss")
  echo text.value
cases.checked_body_status: The provider-owned Box identity and field TypeRef are checked source-backed/v9 and source-free v10; this language has no nominal methods, so structural member calls are covered separately.

cases.category: open Map key/value types, indexed mutation and indexed read
cases.provider:

export fn insert_and_read(values, key, value) -> Int:
  values[key] = value
  return values[key]
cases.checked_body_status: Valid Map operation and key/value specialization are checked in source-backed/v9; v10 admission is not inferred from ordinary concrete Map functions.
Valid source-backed/v9 branch and early-return controls; v10 admission requires checked control-flow facts.

cases.category: explicit let/var bindings, assignment and while loop
cases.provider:
module Service

export fn count_up(value) -> Int:
  let target = value
  var count = 0
  while count < target:
    count = count + 1
  return count
cases.checked_body_status: Source-backed/v9 controls cover explicit immutable/mutable binding, rebinding and while flow; v10 must preserve checked scope and loop semantics or reject callable selection.
cases.evidence: src/ast.hpp: Stmt::Kind::Let, Var, Assign and While

cases.category: match with a provider-owned enum and a separate open parameter
cases.provider:
module Service

export enum Outcome:
  Ready(value: Int)
  Empty

export fn unwrap(adjustment, outcome: Outcome) -> Int:
  match outcome:
    case Ready(value):
      return value + adjustment
    case Empty:
      return adjustment
cases.checked_body_status: Exhaustive match is valid in an open generic body when the match value has a statically closed provider enum type; v10 support is classified separately.

cases.category: typed functional pipeline operation and placeholder expression
cases.checked_body_status: Pipeline validity and source-free v9 execution are controls; v10 must preserve checked operation identity and type requirements or reject selection.

cases.category: raise, try/recover and exceptional control flow
cases.checked_body_status: Probe source-backed validity and v9 native behavior of a generic body with inferred raise set before classifying v10 support.
